final: SELECT AVG(group_avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandusagepct, AVG(group_telescope_count) AS avg_of_group_telescope_count FROM (SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS group_avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS group_telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile)
